scheme_name: Maintenance Allowance To VJNT And SBC Students Studying In Professional Courses And Living In Hostel Attached To Professional Colleges
other_conditions: Students must belong to the VJNT or SBC category
Students must be enrolled in professional courses such as Medical, Engineering, Animal Husbandry, etc.
Students must submit an application form for admission in a government hostel
Students must be admitted to hostels attached to professional colleges or approved private hostels
benefits_summary: Maintenance allowance of Rs. 700 per month for 4‑5 year professional courses and Rs. 500 per month for shorter courses, payable for 10 months.
documents_required: Application form for admission in Govt. Hostel
